Constitution adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 26 November 1949, now Constitution Day (db/pyq/wbcs-prelims-2022.json, Q174). Taught via claim c01 and the constitution_day section.
Question: on which date was the Constitution of India adopted? Answer 26 November 1949 (db/pyq/wbp-constable-2021.json, Q54). Taught via claim c01.

Question: the Constitution of India came into force on — 26 January 1950 (db/pyq/wbpsc-clerkship-2006.json, Q19). The chapter teaches the full trap: adopted 26 November 1949 vs in force 26 January 1950 (claim c01, date_traps section, q45).
